original.statement: Flux v2.7.0 adds OpenTelemetry tracing for Kustomization and HelmRelease reconciliation (Provider).

decision.reason: [ev-0b599c9a3d11] describes a new tracing feature for both Kustomization and HelmRelease reconciliation, delivered through a `Provider`. Using a HelmRelease therefore does not expose an environment to it. The proposed condition, any use of HelmRelease, is too narrow because it leaves out Kustomization. It is also wrong because it never refers to the Provider that the feature works through. The highlight does not name the Provider's group, type value or field that turns tracing on, so no correct exposure condition can be built from this evidence.
